scope: Cross-section information architecture as rebuilt in the v3.54.0 wave. For each section: title / purpose / primary action / secondary action / next best action / preview action / blocker indicator / help link.

global_navigation.command_palette: Ctrl+K — open studio command palette (33 actions per v3.53.0 registry)

overview.title: Overview
overview.purpose: Studio OS home — single cockpit surface answering what needs attention, what is ready, what changed, what is blocked
overview.secondary_action: Open any of the 5 mode cards (Experience / Automation / Output / Launch / Control)
overview.next_best_action: Surfaced in mission hero — driven by studio_recommendations[0]
overview.preview_action: Live previews triptych card (driven by studio_role_preview_entries)
overview.blocker_indicator: Open blockers signal-strip tile (overview_signals['open_blockers']); honest unknown placeholder when None

experience.title: Experience
experience.purpose: Visual experience control room — design surfaces, tenant-safe live preview, theme/page/component state
experience.preview_action: experience_live_preview_pane.html — iframe + role selector + state badges
experience.blocker_indicator: theme_contrast_report status pill in workbench context column
experience.help: Studio guidance panel + Customizer overview CTA

automation.title: Automation
automation.purpose: Workflow simulation cockpit — trigger/action map, simulation preview, approval state, rollback posture
automation.next_best_action: Run simulation on a draft workflow
automation.preview_action: automation_simulation_preview_pane.html — trigger context + projected actions + risks + affected-record count
automation.blocker_indicator: Risk warnings on workflow health panel; failing_count + paused_count from extended workflow health service
automation.help: Flow gallery CTA in right-rail when current_mode='automation'

output.title: Outputs
output.purpose: Output readiness center — report/document/export/public/portal output preview + publish readiness + version state
output.next_best_action: Resolve missing-data warnings on packs with missing deps
output.preview_action: output_readiness_preview_pane.html — per-pack state badges + readiness service-state indicator

launch.title: Launch
launch.purpose: Launch readiness command center — checklist, rollout timeline, blockers, approvals, operator vs tenant responsibilities
launch.blocker_indicator: Active blockers via launch_readiness_summary (deferred — empty list today)

control.title: Control
control.purpose: Governance cockpit — audit summary, rollback control, dependency graph, permissions, feature flags bridge, risk state
control.preview_action: control_governance_preview_pane.html — proposed change + impact + dependency + audit-trail + rollback plan
control.blocker_indicator: Risk state tiles (active flags, pending rollbacks, recent destructive — backend deferred)

no_dead_ends: Every section has a primary action that resolves to a real route or an honest empty state. Pre-existing v3.53 button-as-link in cockpit_copilot_rail.html was converted to <button> in the v3.54.0 closeout — zero NEW href="#" in any v3.54.0 partial.
right_rail_branches: not current_mode (244-265 — NEW v3.54.0 Overview branch with launch-readiness mirror + NBA CTA)
else fallback (266-268 — generic 'Preview, compare, and publish from the canvas')
